footnote_text: Shares of common stock were granted to the reporting person under the Issuer's Independent Director Restricted Share Plan. These shares were issued on account of the reporting person's service as a non-employee director of the Issuer and without additional consideration. The shares become vested in equal installments of 33-1/3% on September 16, 2027, September 16, 2028 and September 16, 2029, subject to the reporting person's continued service to the Issuer, provided that 100% of any then unvested shares becomes fully vested upon the consummation of a liquidity event or the reporting person's death or disability. || Includes shares of common stock previously acquired through the Issuer's Distribution Reinvestment Plan (DRP).
